testcase.name: Persian/Arabic characters, digits and invisible separators normalize consistently
product references are extracted without fetching arbitrary hosts
input validation rejects invalid ranges, unknown fields and excessive limits
identical concurrent reads coalesce, cache keeps original timestamp, TTL expires
invalid upstream structure is reported and evicted from cache
cache eviction respects both entry and response-byte bounds
the client refuses external origins and write/redirect paths
403/429 responses are not retried and pause queued requests
timeouts, non-JSON responses and oversize bodies have distinct errors
a transient 5xx retries once and the upstream gate serializes calls
official SDK client connects over HTTP and invokes every registered tool
HTTP supports 2025 initialization and tool errors keep a machine-readable code
stdio transport emits parseable JSON lines and handles initialize/list/call
Node listener rejects foreign Host/Origin, requires configured bearer and caps body size
Worker entry requires a secret and serves metadata when configured
search removes ads and outside-budget results, uses the observed Torob filter names
uncertain search matches and unknown availability stay visible
price sorting does not put missing prices ahead of actual prices
seller lists are loaded, sorted and deduplicated, with shop scores separate from product ratings
partial seller lists are labelled and offline contact endpoints are never fetched
a seller-list URL cannot redirect the client to another origin or another product
comparison returns differing specs and null for missing values
batch results expose partial failures rather than replacing failed items
cheapest scans bounded pages and deduplicates products
filter discovery and category browsing preserve usable IDs
